eTag.Description: If eTag is provided in the response body, it may also be provided as a header per the normal etag convention.  Entity tags are used for comparing two or more entities from the same requested resource. HTTP/1.1 uses entity tags in the etag (section 14.19), If-Match (section 14.24), If-None-Match (section 14.26), and If-Range (section 14.27) header fields.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

principalId.Description: The service principal ID of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

tenantId.Description: The tenant ID of the system assigned identity. This property will only be provided for a system assigned identity.

type.Description: Type of managed service identity (where both SystemAssigned and UserAssigned types are allowed).

userAssignedIdentities.Description: The set of user assigned identities associated with the resource. The userAssignedIdentities dictionary keys will be ARM resource ids in the form: '/subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/{identityName}. The dictionary values can be empty objects ({}) in requests.

principalId.Description: The principal ID of the assigned identity.

clientId.Description: The client ID of the assigned identity.

name.Description: The name of the SKU. E.g. P3. It is typically a letter+number code

tier.Description: This field is required to be implemented by the Resource Provider if the service has more than one tier, but is not required on a PUT.

size.Description: The SKU size. When the name field is the combination of tier and some other value, this would be the standalone code.

family.Description: If the service has different generations of hardware, for the same SKU, then that can be captured here.

capacity.Description: If the SKU supports scale out/in then the capacity integer should be included. If scale out/in is not possible for the resource this may be omitted.

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

aliasName.Description: Client-facing routing name sent in the request model field.

backendModels.Description: Ordered target models used for routing.

sessionBackendPreference.Description: Stateless backend preference using an existing caller session key.

autoModelSelection.Description: Automatic model selection settings used with the autoModelSelection stage.

failures.Description: Ordered failure rules; only the first matching rule is applied.

maxRetryAttempts.Description: Maximum additional backend attempts after the first request.

supportedEndpoints.Description: Native endpoints common to every target model; translated endpoints are excluded.

gatewayEndpoints.Description: Invocation endpoints, when endpoint metadata is enabled for this gateway.

policies.Description: Inline policies applied to requests routed through the alias.

resourceId.Description: Azure resource identifier of the target model in the default workspace.

selectorModelName.Description: Unversioned canonical model name grouping equivalent serving deployments.

when.Description: Optional Boolean CEL expression wrapped in @cel(...) controlling eligibility for new backend selections.

priority.Description: Routing priority. Lower values are preferred; the effective default is zero.

weight.Description: Relative selection weight within a priority group. The effective default is one.

key.Description: CEL expression returning the caller session key.

allowedRequestOverrides.Description: Allowed per-request behaviors. Omitting the property or sending an empty array denies overrides and disables function-tool compatibility filtering.

when.Description: Boolean @cel(...) expression evaluated against the current routing failure.

retryAttempts.Description: Maximum additional attempts on the same backend; defaults to zero.

excludeFor.Description: Optional ISO 8601 duration or duration-valued @cel(...) expression for excluding the failed backend.

baseUrl.Description: HTTPS base URL for SDKs that construct operation paths, when metadata is enabled.

api.Description: API identifier relative to the provider prefix, when metadata is enabled.

scope.Description: Policy scope. Workspace counter policies use workspace; other policies use resource. Agent hooks require an explicit resource scope.

id.Description: Stable identifier, required for costLimit and agentHooks policies.

count.Description: Token or request count allowed during a tokenLimit or requestRateLimit period.

period.Description: Counter period. Token limits support minute/hour/day; request rate limits support minute/hour/day or whole-second ISO 8601 durations (e.g., PT37S); cost limits support hour/day/week/month/year.

counterKey.Description: Unique public dimensions used to partition a token, cost, or request counter.

overrides.Description: Ordered cost-budget overrides; supported only for counterKey [identity]. The first match wins.

preInvocation.Description: Whether to check tool requests for threats.

postInvocation.Description: Whether to check tool responses for threats.

mode.Description: Default failure mode for agent hooks.

endpoint.Description: Default destination URL for agent hooks.

authentication.Description: Default outbound authentication for agent hooks.

headers.Description: Literal non-secret default HTTP headers for agent hooks.

hooks.Description: Lifecycle hooks; requires agent-hook authoring to be enabled on the gateway.

threshold.Description: Consecutive failure count that opens a fallback circuit.

tripDurationSeconds.Description: Duration for which the fallback circuit remains open.

cidrRanges.Description: CIDR ranges to allow or deny.

allowedOrigins.Description: Origins allowed by a CORS policy.

allowedMethods.Description: HTTP methods allowed by a CORS policy.

allowedHeaders.Description: HTTP headers allowed by a CORS policy.

exposeHeaders.Description: Response headers exposed to the browser.

terminateUnmatchedRequest.Description: Whether unmatched CORS requests are terminated.

preflightResultMaxAge.Description: Browser preflight cache duration in seconds.

claims.Description: Authenticated token claims that must all match; claim names are case-sensitive.

apiKeyResourceId.Description: Azure resource identifier of the API key selecting this override.

managedIdentity.Description: Managed identity configuration for the hook endpoint.

headers.Description: Secret HTTP headers injected when calling the hook endpoint.

resource.Description: Target Entra resource or audience URI requested for managed identity authentication.

clientId.Description: Client ID of a user-assigned managed identity; omit for system-assigned identity.

value.Description: Secret HTTP header value. Omitted from ordinary read responses.

preToolCall.Description: Hook invoked before calling a tool.

postToolCall.Description: Hook invoked after calling a tool.

preModelCall.Description: Hook invoked before calling a model.

postModelCall.Description: Hook invoked after calling a model.

mode.Description: Failure mode when the hook call fails.
